scripts.gallery: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace=kiso-gallery
scripts.build:gallery: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=kiso-gallery
scripts.prototype: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace=kiso-react-prototype
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run check:generated && npm run check:tokens
scripts.check:generated: git diff --exit-code -- tokens/build/ crates/kiso-tokens/src/tokens.rs && node scripts/sync-crate-version.mjs --check
scripts.check:tokens: node scripts/validate-dtcg.mjs && node scripts/check-contrast.mjs tokens/tokens.json && node scripts/check-chart-palette.mjs && node scripts/check-component-token-refs.mjs
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@momoi-labs/kiso && npm run build --workspace=@momoi-labs/kiso-react
scripts.build:demo: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=kiso-react-prototype
scripts.check:react: npm run build:demo && node scripts/check-metrics.mjs && node --test packages/kiso-react/tests/*.test.mjs && node scripts/check-react-package.mjs
scripts.version:packages: changeset version && node scripts/sync-crate-version.mjs && npm install --package-lock-only
